the potential public health risks associated with the importation of bush meat and smoked fish into Europe.
the potential risks of importing meat from West and Central African countries.
the potential public health risks of illegally imported bushmeat and smoked fish.

the illegal importation of African bushmeat into Europe is a potential risk to human and animal health and the environment.

illegal imports of bushmeat and smoked fish are a potential risk for human health and should be stopped.
